summary: Macula temporal to the disc: a darker, vessel-free centre (fovea) with a bright foveal reflex in the young.

diameter.note: Anatomical macula (between the temporal arcades), centred on the fovea.

fovea_diameter.note: Fovea; its centre is the foveal avascular zone, about 0.5 mm across, where no vessel enters.

foveola_diameter.note: Foveola, the floor of the foveal pit.

pigment.note: Fraction of linear reflectance lost at the fovea from the extra RPE and luteal pigment (the reference: 0.21 against 0.42 in red); render calibration.

foveal_reflex.note: Strength of the bright point reflex from the foveal pit; fades with age; render calibration (low).

clinical.notes: Fundus coordinates: millimetres on the retina from the foveal centre, +x temporal, +y up, the same for both eyes (the renderer mirrors the left eye).

provenance.source: Kanski's Clinical Ophthalmology, 9th ed.; Remington, Clinical Anatomy and Physiology of the Visual System, 3rd ed.
